description: Sells sponsor slots in a developer newsletter you publish: a sellability verdict, a rate card priced from measured human clicks, an acceptance policy, an ad label valid in the US, UK, EU and Germany, booking terms and the sponsor report. Use whenever someone asks what to charge for a newsletter sponsorship, wants a media kit or rate card for a developer, community or open-source newsletter, gets a sponsor inquiry, weighs a sponsor's dedicated send or sponsored review in the newsletter, or asks how to label an ad in a newsletter issue - even if they only say 'a company wants to pay for a mention in our newsletter'. Not for pricing your own ad buy in someone else's newsletter. Do NOT use for whether to carry paid placements at all - use samber/developer-relations-skills@devrel-newsletter-program.
